name: unk80
meaning: Zeroed at the moment the crate opens (0x49d106) and referenced nowhere else in 0x49ce30-0x49d301. Named by offset on purpose.

name: state
meaning: 0 idle/parked, 1 falling (driven down 800/s with a landing test), 2 opening (waiting for the open animation, then it removes itself from the world and returns to 0).

name: canRelease
meaning: Gate on the release step: set by Init/Reset and by msg 0x30, cleared by msg 0x31. With it clear the crate does not sit quietly — the jump at 0x49d04e skips the state change too, so it stays in state 1 and keeps applying 800/s downward every frame.
